title: 第03章 必由之路

content_zh:
“或许是因为缺德事儿做多了吧，晚年以来，老夫修桥补路、捐学助残，又往庙里施舍了大笔的香油钱，一个劲儿地积阴德，可还是换不来一个儿子，不得已，只好从族人里过继了一个。”
杨霖惆怅地叹了口气，道：“可他毕竟不是老夫的亲骨肉啊。老夫这一辈子就只生了一个女儿，她的母亲是老夫的妾室，素来不受夫人待见，老夫担心死后夫人肆无忌惮，会难为她们母女。”
叶小天疑惑地道：“那杨大人的意思是？”
杨霖哽咽地道：“我那女儿，乖巧伶俐，俊俏可爱，可恨老夫那时只顾恋栈权位，不曾多多承受膝下之欢，如今追悔莫及。老夫触犯国法纲纪，固然死有余辜，如今心头唯一牵挂的，就只有这个女儿了。”
他把目光缓缓定在叶小天身上，说道：“老夫想修书一封，请你转交老夫家里，让他们按照老夫的意思分割家产，给小女留一份嫁妆，保她一生衣食无忧，你可愿意？”
叶小天诧异地道：“这就是大人所说的大事？”
杨霖郑重地点了点头，道：“不错！老夫掌了一辈子权，贪了一辈子钱，死到临头才终于明白，对我来说究竟什么才是最重要的，这就是老夫心中最重要的事！”
叶小天慨然道：“使得！就不冲着五十两银子，这样的善举我也该去做的，当然，有钱更好，哈哈！只是……既然牵涉到分割家产，小子我红口白牙的，说出去怕也没人信，还需大人你留书一封作为证物，待我去取笔墨纸砚来。”
杨霖感激地道：“好！老夫家住湖广道靖州府，只要你替老夫把这封信送到，五十两银子的酬劳必一分不少！”
叶小天蓦然瞪起眼睛，惊讶地道：“湖广道靖州府？听你这话音儿，这个地方应该不在北京城吧？”
杨霖奇怪地看了他一眼，道：“靖州府就是靖州府，当然不在北京城，怎么？”
不在北京城，那究竟在什么地方？长这么大，最远只到过通州的叶小天脑海中马上幻现出一片《山海经》里的莽荒世界景象，他把头摇得跟拨浪鼓似的：“不不不，那可不成，离了北京地界儿，我就找不到北了。”
杨霖截口道：“五百两！老夫给你五百两的酬劳，如何？这可是你一辈子都挣不到的钱！”
“五百两……”叶小天怦然心动，可这种挣扎只持续了片刻，就坚决地摇了摇头。要去湖广送信，湖广啊！在这交通不便、通讯不便的年代，听着仿佛有天涯那么远……
对于从不曾离开北京的叶小天来说，这是一听就让他从心底里感到徬徨的畏途。他犹豫了一下，还是拒绝道：“实在是太遥远了，不如等你家人到京时我再转交……”
杨霖惨然一笑，道：“老夫在牢里关了三年，自从知道老夫再不可能出去，家里就没人来过了，老夫与夫人一向感情淡漠，若等她安排人千里迢迢来运我灵柩，却不知要等到何年何月去了。”
叶小天一听“千里迢迢”四字，更是不肯答应了，连连摇头道：“小天不成，杨大人您另请高明吧。”
杨霖道：“老夫还能请托何人？这偌大一个天牢里，有好人么？”
叶小天的脸色登时一僵。
杨霖喟然道：“牢里这些犯官，时常使些银钱让你们狱卒去买吃用，老夫冷眼旁观，旁的狱卒无不克扣，或以次充好或多贪银钱，只有你最重然诺，虽然贪利却不背信，所以也只有你老夫才能相信。”

叶小天摇头道：“大人抬举了，这趟门儿实在走得远了些，小天我就是家门口池塘里的一条小泥鳅，没见过什么风浪的，您这件事儿小子我实在办不了，告辞！”
叶小天拱一拱手，转身就走，杨霖在他身后高声叫道：“五百两、五百两啊，足以让你一生富贵了，难道你甘心做一辈子小小牢头儿？”
叶小天没有回头，只是疾步而去，远远的，传出他字正腔圆的一段昆曲儿：“我本是~~~四九城中的小家雀儿，何必要翱翔九天做鲲鹏，鲲鹏不知燕雀的好~~~”
叶小天的声音渐去渐远，杨霖痴痴地站在原地，扶栏听着他的声音，许久许久才慢慢仰起头来，望着阴沉沉的牢顶，喃喃一声长叹：“鲲鹏，或许真的不及燕雀好啊……”

content_en:
"Perhaps it's because I have done too many immoral things. In my later years, I built bridges and roads, donated money to schools and aided the disabled, and donated a large amount of sesame oil money to the temple. I kept accumulating virtue, but I still couldn't get a son. I had no choice but to adopt one from the clan."
Yang Lin sighed melancholy and said: "But he is not my blood after all. I have only given birth to one daughter in my life. Her mother is my concubine and has never been favored by my wife. I am worried that my wife will be unscrupulous after death and will make things difficult for them."
Ye Xiaotian asked doubtfully: "What does Mr. Yang mean?"
Yang Lin choked up and said: "My daughter is well-behaved, smart, handsome and cute. It's a pity that I only cared about power and position at that time and didn't receive much pleasure from my knees. Now I regret it. I broke the national laws and regulations, and I certainly deserved to die. Now the only thing I care about is this daughter."
He slowly fixed his gaze on Ye Xiaotian and said: "I want to repair a letter. Please give it to my family so that they can divide the family property according to my wishes, leave a dowry for my daughter, and ensure that she has no worries about food and clothing throughout her life. Are you willing?"
Ye Xiaotian said in surprise: "Is this the big event that adults call it?"
Yang Lin nodded solemnly and said: "That's right! I have been in power and greedy for money all my life. Only when I was about to die did I finally understand what is most important to me. This is the most important thing in my heart!"
Ye Xiaotian said with emotion: "That's right! I should do such a good deed even if it's not for fifty taels of silver. Of course, it's better to have money, haha! But... since it involves dividing the family property, I have a red mouth and white teeth. I'm afraid no one will believe me if I tell you. I need you to leave a letter as evidence for me to get pen, ink, paper and inkstone."
Yang Lin said gratefully: "Okay! I live in Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang Road. As long as you deliver this letter for me, you will be paid fifty taels of silver!"
Ye Xiaotian suddenly opened his eyes and said in surprise: "Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang Road? From what you said, this place shouldn't be in Beijing, right?"
Yang Lin glanced at him strangely and said, "Jingzhou Prefecture is Jingzhou Prefecture. Of course it's not in Beijing. Why?"
If it’s not in Beijing, then where exactly is it? Ye Xiaotian, who has only been as far as Tongzhou in his life, immediately imagined a scene of the wild world in "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" in his mind. He shook his head like a rattle: "No, no, no, that can't be done. I can't find the north outside the boundaries of Beijing."
Yang Lin interrupted: "Five hundred taels! How about I give you five hundred taels as a reward? This is money you will never earn in your life!"
"Five hundred taels..." Ye Xiaotian's heart pounded, but the struggle only lasted for a moment before he shook his head resolutely. I’m going to Huguang to deliver a letter, Huguang! In this era of inconvenient transportation and communication, it sounds like the end of the world is so far away...
For Ye Xiaotian, who has never left Beijing, this is a fearful path that makes him feel hesitant from the bottom of his heart. He hesitated for a moment, but still refused: "It's really too far away, why not wait until your family arrives in Beijing and then I'll hand it over..."
Yang Lin smiled miserably and said: "I have been in prison for three years. Ever since I knew that I would never be able to get out, no one has been to my house. My relationship with my wife has always been indifferent. If I wait for her to arrange for someone to travel thousands of miles to transport my coffin, I don't know what year or month it will be until I am gone."
When Ye Xiaotian heard the words "thousands of miles away", he even refused to agree. He shook his head repeatedly and said: "Xiaotian can't do it. Mr. Yang, please hire someone else."
Yang Lin said: "Who else can I ask for help? Are there any good people in this big prison?"
Ye Xiaotian's face suddenly froze.
Yang Lin sighed and said: "These prisoners in the prison often give some money to your jailers to buy food. I watch with cold eyes. The other jailers all deduct money, pass it off as good, or are greedy for money. You are the only one."The most important thing is that although you are greedy for profit, you will not break your promise, so only you, old man, can believe it. "
Ye Xiaotian shook his head and said: "Your Majesty, you have gone too far this time. Xiaotian, I am just a little loach in the pond at the door of my house. I have never seen any storms. I really can't handle your matter, kid. Say goodbye!" "
Ye Xiaotian cupped his hands, turned around and left. Yang Lin shouted loudly behind him: "Five hundred taels, five hundred taels, it's enough to make you rich for a lifetime. Are you willing to be a little prison boss for the rest of your life? "
Ye Xiaotian didn't look back, just walked away quickly. From a distance, a piece of Kunqu opera he sang with perfect words was heard: "I am originally~~~a small bird in the Forty-Nine City, why do I need to fly to the nine heavens to be a Kunpeng? Kunpeng doesn't know how good a sparrow is~~~"
Ye Xiaotian's voice gradually faded away. Yang Lin stood there foolishly, listening to his voice on the railing. After a long time, he slowly raised his head, looked at the gloomy ceiling of the prison, and murmured a long sigh: "Kunpeng, maybe it's really not as good as Yanque..."
